name: distributed-agent-recovery
description: Distributed AI workflow recovery, saga compensation, and zombie worker lease fencing with AGBoss

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e 'import("node:fs").then(f => f.cpSync("src", "dist/src", { recursive: true, filter: p => !p.endsWith(".ts") }))'
scripts.demo:compose: sh -c 'docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up -d --build --wait worker-alpha worker-beta && docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml run --rm -T --no-deps coordinator node dist/src/demo.js; CODE=$?; docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml down -v; exit $CODE'
